knowledge_points.title: Monte Carlo estimation
knowledge_points.summary: Use repeated random samples to estimate a quantity such as π.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: 用10000个样本做蒙特卡洛实验估计π
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 为什么蒙特卡洛估计需要重复抽样？

knowledge_points.title: Sample mean
knowledge_points.summary: Interpret the sample mean as the estimator produced by repeated trials.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 样本均值在蒙特卡洛实验中估计什么？

knowledge_points.title: Law of large numbers
knowledge_points.summary: Observe how an estimate stabilizes as the sample size grows.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 样本量增大时，蒙特卡洛估计通常会怎样变化？

knowledge_points.title: Standard error
knowledge_points.summary: Relate sampling variability to the inverse square root of the sample size.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 为什么把样本量扩大四倍通常会降低估计误差？

knowledge_points.title: Bernoulli process
knowledge_points.summary: Model independent arrivals in discrete time with a fixed event probability.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: 伯努利过程：时间槽数为100、事件概率为0.3、路径数为500
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 伯努利过程中的每个时间槽代表什么？

knowledge_points.title: Binomial counts
knowledge_points.summary: Compare the accumulated Bernoulli arrivals with a binomial distribution.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 为什么固定时间槽内的伯努利到达数服从二项分布？

knowledge_points.title: Geometric waiting time
knowledge_points.summary: Study the first-arrival waiting time in a Bernoulli process.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 事件概率降低时，首次到达等待时间会如何变化？

knowledge_points.title: Poisson process
knowledge_points.summary: Use independent increments and exponential interarrival times in continuous time.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: 模拟强度为2、时长为5的泊松过程，使用200条路径
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 为什么 Poisson 过程的计数均值是 λt？

knowledge_points.title: Random-walk increments
knowledge_points.summary: Build a discrete-time walk from independent up and down steps.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: 用500条路径模拟100步随机游走，并比较理论均值
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 向上概率大于 0.5 时，终点均值会朝哪个方向移动？

knowledge_points.title: Drift and variance
knowledge_points.summary: Compare empirical endpoint mean and variance with their theoretical values.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 为什么随机游走的均值和方差都依赖步数？

knowledge_points.title: Hitting probability
knowledge_points.summary: Estimate the chance that a walk reaches a boundary before another boundary.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 赌徒破产问题中的边界代表什么？

knowledge_points.title: Absorption time
knowledge_points.summary: Interpret the number of steps until a boundary is reached.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 什么因素会影响随机游走到达边界所需的时间？

knowledge_points.title: Poisson jump times
knowledge_points.summary: Use Poisson arrivals as the random clock for a continuous-time walk.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: 连续时间随机游走：跳跃率为2、时长为5、路径数为500
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 连续时间随机游走的跳跃时刻为什么是随机的？

knowledge_points.title: Continuous-time sample paths
knowledge_points.summary: Interpret the path as piecewise constant between jump times.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 为什么连续时间随机游走的路径在跳跃之间保持不变？

knowledge_points.title: Jump-rate effects
knowledge_points.summary: Compare how the jump rate changes the number of moves in a fixed horizon.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 提高跳跃率会怎样改变固定时长内的路径？

knowledge_points.title: Gaussian increments
knowledge_points.summary: Study Brownian increments as independent normal random variables.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: 用500条路径模拟T为1、网格数为200的布朗运动，解释终点方差
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 布朗运动的独立增量表示什么？

knowledge_points.title: Brownian scaling
knowledge_points.summary: Compare a scaled random walk with Brownian motion.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 随机游走如何在缩放后逼近布朗运动？

knowledge_points.title: Terminal distribution
knowledge_points.summary: Verify that B(T) has mean zero and variance T.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 为什么 B(T) 的方差随 T 线性增长？

knowledge_points.title: Hitting events
knowledge_points.summary: Use sample paths to discuss reaching a prescribed level.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 单条布朗路径与许多路径的 hitting event 统计有什么区别？

knowledge_points.title: Transition matrix
knowledge_points.summary: Use a transition matrix to specify one-step state changes.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: 模拟500步马尔可夫链并比较平稳分布
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 转移矩阵的一行为什么要加总为 1？

knowledge_points.title: Markov Property
knowledge_points.summary: Explain why the next state depends on the present state rather than the full past.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 马尔可夫性质排除了关于过去的哪类额外信息？

knowledge_points.title: Stationary Distribution
knowledge_points.summary: Compare long-run empirical state frequencies with a stationary distribution.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 为什么平稳分布满足 πP=π？

knowledge_points.title: Absorption and gambler's ruin
knowledge_points.summary: Apply a Markov chain to absorbing boundaries and ruin events.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 吸收状态进入后为什么不会离开？

knowledge_points.title: Holding times
knowledge_points.summary: Describe how long a continuous-time Markov chain stays in a state.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: 连续时间马尔可夫链：故障率为0.25、修复率为0.15、时长为200
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 停留时间和离开率之间有什么关系？

knowledge_points.title: Generator matrix
knowledge_points.summary: Use a generator matrix to encode continuous-time transition rates.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 生成矩阵的对角元为什么通常为负？

knowledge_points.title: Birth-death process
knowledge_points.summary: Model adjacent upward and downward transitions with birth and death rates.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: 模拟出生死亡过程：出生率为0.35、死亡率为0.3、容量为6、时长为500
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 出生率和死亡率如何影响状态路径？

knowledge_points.title: Two-state reliability chain
knowledge_points.summary: Interpret failure and repair as a two-state continuous-time Markov chain.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 故障率提高时，长期正常状态概率会怎样变化？

knowledge_points.title: Survival and hazard functions
knowledge_points.summary: Relate lifetimes to survival functions and hazard rates.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: 可靠性模型：部件1故障率为0.8、部件2故障率为1.2
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: survival function 和 hazard rate 分别描述什么？

knowledge_points.title: Series and parallel systems
knowledge_points.summary: Compare system lifetimes under series and parallel arrangements.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 为什么串联系统寿命取部件寿命的最小值？

knowledge_points.title: Batch buffer model
knowledge_points.summary: Track arrivals and service in a finite-capacity buffer.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: 缓冲区模型：到达概率为0.6、容量为10、步数为500、路径数为200
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 到达速度超过服务能力时，buffer 会出现什么趋势？

knowledge_points.title: M/M/1 queue
knowledge_points.summary: Study Poisson arrivals, exponential service and the stability condition λ<μ.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: M/M/1 queue：到达率为0.75、服务率为1、时长为2000
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 为什么 λ 接近 μ 时平均队长会迅速增加？

knowledge_points.title: Time-varying intensity
knowledge_points.summary: Describe a Poisson process whose event rate changes over time.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 时变强度和齐次 Poisson 过程的固定强度有什么区别？

knowledge_points.title: Thinning algorithm
knowledge_points.summary: Generate candidate events and accept them according to a time-varying rate.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: 非齐次泊松过程 thinning：基础强度为2、峰值增量为6、高峰时刻为13
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: thinning 中为什么需要一个上界强度？

knowledge_points.title: Integrated intensity
knowledge_points.summary: Compare the mean count with the integral of the intensity function.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 为什么积分强度给出期望事件数？

knowledge_points.title: Self-avoidance
knowledge_points.summary: Construct a walk that never revisits a previously visited site.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: 自避免游走：最大步数为1000、实验次数为500
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 为什么自避免游走不能只由当前位置决定下一步？

knowledge_points.title: Path trapping
knowledge_points.summary: Observe that a growing path can exhaust all available neighbouring sites.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 路径如何把自己困住？

knowledge_points.title: Stopping length
knowledge_points.summary: Compare stopping lengths over repeated self-avoiding walks.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 实验次数增加后，停止长度的经验分布如何帮助理解受困？

knowledge_points.title: Random particle motion
knowledge_points.summary: Move particles randomly on a discrete circle.
knowledge_points.simulation_prompt: 圆上粒子合并：圆周大小为12、粒子数为9、实验次数为200
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 圆周大小如何影响粒子相遇的机会？

knowledge_points.title: Coalescence
knowledge_points.summary: Merge particles when they meet and track the number of clusters.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 为什么簇数量在合并过程中不会增加？

knowledge_points.title: Coalescence time
knowledge_points.summary: Summarize the time until all particles have merged into one cluster.
knowledge_points.practice_prompt: 初始粒子数增加时，完全合并时间可能如何变化？
